text:
### Step 6: Property Valuation & Risk  
**Property Value Assessment:**  
**Risk Factors:**  
| Factor | Low Risk | Medium Risk | High Risk |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Location** | Prime area, stable values | Growing suburban | Declining area |
| **Property Type** | House, flat | Newer construction | Listed building, unusual |
| **Condition** | Modern, good repair | Average condition | Poor, repairs needed |
| **Market Liquidity** | Easy to sell, buyers | Moderate sales | Hard to sell, few buyers |  
**Valuation Approach:**
1. Order independent professional valuation (surveyor)
2. Compare to comparable properties (market data)
3. Apply location/condition adjustments
4. Confirm valuation supports LTV ratio  
**If Valuation < Purchase Price:**
- Reduction triggers higher LTV
- May require renegotiation or additional deposit
- May require borrower to make up shortfall

raw_entities.name: Property Location Risk
raw_entities.description: Risk assessment factor evaluating property location stability and market conditions. Ranges from prime areas with stable values (low risk) through growing suburban areas (medium risk) to declining areas (high risk). Location directly impacts property value sustainability and collateral quality.
context: Location | Prime area, stable values | Growing suburban | Declining area

raw_entities.name: Property Type Risk
raw_entities.description: Risk assessment factor evaluating the property type and construction characteristics. Standard property types (houses, flats) present low risk, newer construction presents medium risk, and unusual properties such as listed buildings present high risk due to valuation and marketability challenges.
context: Property Type | House, flat | Newer construction | Listed building, unusual

raw_entities.name: Property Condition Risk
raw_entities.description: Risk assessment factor evaluating the physical condition and state of repair of the property. Modern properties in good repair present low risk, average condition properties present medium risk, and properties requiring significant repairs present high risk to collateral value.
context: Condition | Modern, good repair | Average condition | Poor, repairs needed

raw_entities.name: Market Liquidity Risk
raw_entities.description: Risk assessment factor evaluating the ease and speed with which a property can be sold in the market. Properties easy to sell with active buyer interest present low risk, moderate sales activity presents medium risk, and properties hard to sell with few buyers present high risk to recovery in default scenarios.
context: Market Liquidity | Easy to sell, buyers | Moderate sales | Hard to sell, few buyers

raw_entities.name: Loan-to-Value Ratio Risk
raw_entities.description: Risk arising when property valuation falls below purchase price, triggering higher LTV and increased credit exposure. May require renegotiation, additional deposit, or borrower shortfall contribution to maintain acceptable risk parameters.
context: May require renegotiation or additional deposit

raw_entities.name: Loan-to-Value Ratio
raw_entities.description: Key risk metric used to assess mortgage lending risk by comparing loan amount to property valuation. LTV must be supported by independent professional valuation and adjusted for location and condition factors. Higher LTV indicates greater credit risk.

raw_entities.name: Order Independent Professional Property Valuation
raw_entities.description: Required action to obtain independent professional valuation from a qualified surveyor as part of property value assessment process. This valuation forms the basis for LTV calculation and risk assessment in mortgage lending decisions.

raw_entities.name: Compare Property to Comparable Market Data
raw_entities.description: Required action to benchmark the subject property against comparable properties in the market to validate valuation. This comparative analysis supports the independent professional valuation and informs location and condition adjustments.

raw_entities.name: Apply Location and Condition Adjustments to Valuation
raw_entities.description: Required action to adjust the base valuation for identified location and condition risk factors. Adjustments reflect the risk matrix assessment (low/medium/high risk categories) to arrive at a final valuation supporting LTV determination.

raw_entities.name: Confirm Valuation Supports LTV Ratio
raw_entities.description: Required action to validate that the final adjusted property valuation is sufficient to support the proposed loan-to-value ratio. If valuation is insufficient, triggers renegotiation, additional deposit requirement, or borrower shortfall contribution.
